'''2012 Worlds Day 2 Darren Pilbeam LS Infiltration''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Darren Pilbeam]] at [[2012 World Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Darren Pilbeam]]
* '''Event:''' [[2012 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Infiltration / Unlikely Allies]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
